name: LIGHT Firmware

dispatch_notes.coder: C code for ESP-IDF components, FreeRTOS tasks, BLE/MQTT handlers
dispatch_notes.reviewer: Focus on memory safety, resource cleanup, esp_err_t handling
dispatch_notes.security-auditor: Secure boot, flash encryption, certificate management, PKCS#11
dispatch_notes.debugger: Serial monitor (idf.py monitor), BLE test scripts, partition analysis
dispatch_notes.ci-cd: GitHub Actions release workflows, multi-env firmware builds

guidance.stack_summary: C / ESP-IDF 5.4 / ESP32-S3 / FreeRTOS / BLE NimBLE / AWS IoT MQTT / CMake
structure: main/ — Entry point (app_main.c), Kconfig hardware selection
components/aws_mqtt_agent/ — AWS IoT connectivity, fleet provisioning
components/command_handler/ — JSON command parser and dispatcher
components/neuronic/ — Hardware drivers (buttons, buzzer, LEDs, PWM, power, state machine)
components/firmware_update/ — OTA firmware update over HTTPS
components/program/ — Treatment program execution with timers
components/transport/ — BLE/MQTT abstraction + SPIFFS message queue
docs/ — Serial ID management, certificate docs, flashing guides
tools/ — Manufacturing tools (UUID generation, factory config)
conventions: ESP-IDF coding style: snake_case functions, UPPERCASE macros
esp_err_t return codes for error handling
ESP_LOG* macros for logging with TAG per component
FreeRTOS queues, timers, event groups for concurrency
ci_cd: Production release: tag v*.rel → builds for all 3 environments → S3 upload + GitHub release
Dev release: tag v*.dev → builds dev only → dev S3 upload
testing: BLE functional test: python test/bletest.py --name Neuronic_Light_XXXXXX

custom_rules: Commands arrive via BLE (primary) or MQTT (when WiFi connected), JSON-based protocol
Partition table: factory NVS (12K unencrypted) + OTA A/B (2MB each) + SPIFFS message queue (3.8MB)
Fleet provisioning uses claim certificates embedded at compile time
Production builds require: cat sdkconfig.secure >> sdkconfig.defaults before build
